# Tender Town

> Specialised AI agents for your next tender. They find opportunities, analyse requirements and prepare proposal briefs.

Tender Town tracks open public procurement across Europe: requests for proposals, requests for information, grants and funding calls, with their documents, summaries and requirements, plus regulation, industry and market news. The agents do three jobs: find opportunities, analyse tender requirements, and prepare proposal briefs. Choose a market, or create a custom scope so the agents work to that business. Visitors see the General scope, ranked without a language model. Each scope has configurable agents that fetch and summarise tenders and news, pull documents, and list requirements. On Pro and Teams they also judge the fit and outline how a proposal could be approached, and the News Report Agent writes what to do about a story (50 a month on Pro, unlimited on Teams). Accounts can follow items, post, comment and chat. Paid plans add custom scopes.

The pipeline runs every four hours. It searches TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), national procurement portals, EU funding programmes, development-bank notices, news, and the sources a workspace follows. A tender page starts from the first publication of the procedure and includes later updates.

Tenders, news and community posts are public HTML. No account is required to read them. Each page has a title, a summary, dates, and structured data. New items appear in the sitemap and the feed as the pipeline publishes them.

Signed-out visitors see one preset scope. Presets are ranked from what the browser says the visitor prefers: an explicit `?scope=`, scopes whose pages they have opened, words in the link they arrived from, and their country. The highest-ranked preset that currently has tenders or news is shown. A preferred preset with no results is skipped for the next one. General is used when every preset is empty, or when `?scope=general`. New presets are included automatically. Crawlers always see General. The sitemap and the feed list every public page, not one visitor's scope.

## For agents and search

- [Sitemap](https://tendertown.io/sitemap.xml): every public page, with last-modified dates
- [Feed](https://tendertown.io/feed.xml): the latest tenders, news and posts (RSS)
- [Tenders](https://tendertown.io/tenders): open procedures
- [News](https://tendertown.io/news): regulation, industry and market news
- [Community](https://tendertown.io/community): posts from members
- [MCP guide](https://tendertown.io/mcp.md): how to operate an account. The server is `https://tendertown.io/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer tt_…`). Reading the public pages does not need a token. A token is for creating workspaces and scopes and for plan-limited reports.

## Pages

- [About](https://tendertown.io/about): what the platform is and how it works
- [Pricing](https://tendertown.io/pricing): Free, Starter (€49/month), Pro (€89/month), Teams (€139/month). A year is eleven months. The News Report Agent is on Pro (50 reports a month) and Teams (unlimited). Pro and Teams also judge tender fit and outline how to approach a proposal.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tendertown.io/privacy): how personal data is handled
- [Terms](https://tendertown.io/terms): the terms for using the platform
- [Help](https://tendertown.io/help): how the platform works
- [Tenders](https://tendertown.io/tenders): open tenders. One page per procedure, at `/tenders/{id}`
- [News](https://tendertown.io/news): regulation, industry and market news. One page per story, at `/news/{id}`
- [Community](https://tendertown.io/community): posts from members. One page per post, at `/posts/{id}`
